name: facevector-attendance
description: FaceVector Attendance AI with existing browser application and optional Node/Express/MongoDB security and attendance API

scripts.test: node scripts/check-project.js && node scripts/audit-site.js && node --test tests/core.test.js tests/backend-core.test.js tests/teacher-attendance-access.test.js && node scripts/security-check.js
